text.atlas_air_body: Glide through the mountain landscape. Drag to look, then use the flight controls to move, climb and descend. The camera keeps at least 150 m above the sampled terrain. The compass and height readouts describe your position in this elevation model.
text.atlas_air_export: Flight viewpoint: {east} m east, {north} m north of grid centre; altitude {altitude} m above sea level; heading {heading} degrees; viewing pitch {pitch} degrees. Terrain uses a 75 m grid.
text.atlas_air_map: Your flight position and heading on the terrain map
text.atlas_air_help: Drag to look. Hold W/A/S/D or arrows to move; Q/E descend or climb. Shift boosts speed. Space brakes; R resets; Escape returns to the map. Tap a movement button for 100 m, or hold it to fly.
text.atlas_air_scope: Clearance ≥ 150 m · sampled terrain · illustrated surfaces
text.atlas_air_canvas: Flight through Everest. Drag to look. W A S D or arrows move. Q and E change height. Space brakes. R resets. Escape returns to the terrain map.
